components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary product action with a square silhouette and reserved one-pixel border.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; border: 1px solid transparent; color: #fff; font: 650 13.5px var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--brand); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-deep); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--route-line); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action used beside the hero's primary product action.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 650 13.5px var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline { border-color: var(--border-strong); background: transparent; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--foreground); background: var(--brand-soft); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--route-line); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Icon Control
components.description: Square 38px utility control used for the GitHub action.
components.css: .ds-icon-control { width: 38px; height: 38px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--foreground); background: transparent; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease, background-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-icon-control:hover { color: var(--route-line); border-color: var(--route-line); background: var(--brand-soft); } .ds-icon-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--route-line); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.description: Square bilingual segmented control; the active segment is Route Blue.
components.css: .ds-lang-toggle { height: 38px; padding: 3px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-lang-toggle button { min-width: 36px; height: 30px; border: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); background: transparent; font: 700 10px var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-lang-toggle button[data-active="true"] { color: #fff; background: var(--brand); } .ds-lang-toggle button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--route-line); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-routing-plane { width: min(720px, 100%); position: relative; aspect-ratio: 720 / 520; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-secondary) 32%, transparent); background: linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-secondary) 7%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-secondary) 7%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 32px 32px; } .ds-routing-lines { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 90%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; } .ds-routing-lines path { fill: none; stroke: var(--route-line); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgb(22 93 255 / 0.62)); vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-routing-origin { fill: var(--foreground); stroke: var(--route-line); stroke-width: 2; } .ds-routing-endpoint { fill: var(--surface-raised); stroke: #5e8fe8; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-routing-items { position: absolute; inset: 0; } .ds-routing-item { width: 100%; height: 20%; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 clamp(10px, 0.85vw, 13px) var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-routing-item[data-route="1"] { top: 9.2%; } .ds-routing-item[data-route="2"] { top: 40%; } .ds-routing-item[data-route="3"] { top: 70.8%; } .ds-routing-name { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 4.2%; color: var(--route-line); } .ds-routing-layer { position: absolute; top: 48%; right: 2.2%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--route-line); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-routing-availability { position: absolute; top: 0; left: calc(4.2% + 74px); color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.78em; }

components.name: Product Status

components.css: .ds-repo-row { padding: 24px 0; position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 260px) minmax(0, 1fr) 26px; align-items: center; gap: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 12%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); text-decoration: none; } .ds-repo-row::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 -1px; height: 1px; background: var(--brand); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-repo-row:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-repo-name { font: 620 clamp(17px, 1.9vw, 24px) var(--font-geist-mono), monospace; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-repo-copy { color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 13.5px/1.68 var(--font-geist-sans), Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-repo-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--route-line); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: LafLabs uses a compact, dark-only technical plane: deep navy surfaces, thin blue-grey rules, one structural blue family, and square geometry. The system should feel like infrastructure made legible rather than a collection of marketing cards. Product discovery is primary. The signature routing field connects one company origin to three product paths, while downstream sections continue as direct editorial rows separated by spacing and rules.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, single-theme technical surfaces with one blue accent.
Square endpoints, controls, markers, and corners.
Large Geist Sans headlines paired with restrained Geist Mono labels.
Flat section bands and dividers instead of cards or decorative depth.
Bilingual Korean and English copy with line breaks and measures that survive both locales.

rules.name: The One Route Rule
rules.body: Route Blue is the only accent; do not add competing semantic colors without a product requirement.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Sans carries meaning; mono carries compact system metadata.

rules.name: The Routing Grammar
rules.body: One square origin splits into three paths and ends at three square endpoints. Product name, availability, and infrastructure layer align to those routes; unavailable products remain visible but are not links.

rules.name: The Flat Infrastructure Rule
rules.body: Use borders and surface bands before shadows or floating containers.

rules.name: The Square Signal Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce pills or circular decorative dots. A circle is allowed only when its shape carries real meaning supplied by the product.

dos: Do use Route Blue for filled actions and Readable Blue for small signal text, routes, focus, and live status.
Do keep Korean and English readable with `word-break: keep-all` where prose needs stable phrases.
Do continue sections with generous spacing and one-pixel dividers.
Do preserve existing anchors and working external links.
donts: Don't add rounded cards, pills, decorative circles, or ornamental shadows.
Don't repeat eyebrow labels or section numbers when the heading already establishes context.
Don't add a second marquee or a hero scroll cue.
Don't animate padding or layout position on row hover.
